SUPERVISOR: PLATMOD SLICE 1 — the player binary that loads a game package. User-ruled GO. Cold-start reading order, before any code: (1) docs/game/PLATMOD_PLAN.md IN FULL — it is the plan AND carries the user's fresh rulings inline (naming stands: .rjpkg / rjit pack / rjit play; content store = content-addressed dir in the player's data dir, atomic temp+fsync+rename writes, hash IS the corruption check, mmap reads; Compile dual-writes boot key + mapfile through this slice). (2) docs/game/DECISIONS.md verdicts V28/V29/V30. (3) tools/oracle "platform mod map format player binary package".

Execute §1 + §2 of the plan in its stated build order: lump container → Compile transcode → loader → package shape → player binary boot. The done-bar is §5, all four, none waived: (a) round-trip equality verify script (mapfile-boot vs boot-key-boot, same world facts) added to the verify corpus and GREEN; (b) codec suites BOTH sides — TS and Zig (the testing-parity rule is law); (c) SELFSHOT of the player binary booted on the package, PNG path cited (the app shoots itself, never the desktop); (d) second-mod grep proof: zero cart/hmsc imports in the player boot path.

Explicitly NOT in this slice (§1d): mining, VIS, changelevel, content store beyond the one map. Do not grow scope.

Working rules: do everything yourself in your own context — no subagents. Build via tools/rjit only. The workbench fold is live on other lanes — touch nothing under cart/hmsc-int/editors/ beyond what Compile transcode requires, and report (never fix) any cross-lane verifier red. Post progress at each build-order boundary with evidence; commits land on my word at boundaries I name. If the plan turns out wrong somewhere, say so and stop — the plan amends before the code bends.
